name: io.github.PedroMarkovicz/tekmeria
title: Tekmeria
description: Biomedical evidence from PubMed, trials and FDA labels, with citations an audit can check.

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Raises the PubMed limit from 3 to 10 requests per second.

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact address NCBI asks for; sent only when set.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Raises openFDA's daily limit from 1,000 to 120,000 requests.

environmentVariables.name: CROSSREF_MAILTO
environmentVariables.description: Puts Crossref requests in its polite pool; sent only when set.
